fusions.name: Scale Shed
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 14 damage and is thrown back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Tumbling Charge
fusions.desc: You curl and roll into the target, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Sealed Seams
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Curled Ward
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, a shield worth 30% of your maximum health closes over you for 8 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.
